source_text: Vas fictile confringetur; aeneum defricabitur. Fragilitas carnis; fortitudo castigationis. Vasa in honorem.
pass_a_gloss: Vessel earthen will-be-broken; bronze will-be-scoured. Fragility of-flesh; strength of-chastening. Vessels unto honor.
pass_b_english: An [[earthen vessel is broken; bronze is scoured >> Bible:Leviticus 6:28]]. Flesh is fragile; chastening is strong. Become [[vessels for honor >> Bible:2 Timothy 2:21]].
